entries.reason: Root package scripts explicitly sequence setup/style/catalog/docs/static/tests/build gates; pinned browser/AST dependencies and Node24 engine retain execution authority.

parseRemoteAdminArguments validates allowlisted flags and operator request before manifest/SSH inputs; normalized absolute remote paths and strict known-host identity precede temporary0600 request transfer/cleanup. One remote orchestration remains clear despite293 lines.
Real loopback browser containment fixture records IPv6 sink traffic and asserts sendBeacon/navigation blocked; owned session and both servers close in finally.

Browser wrapper separates command allowlist, URL/argument validation, random owned-session markers and proxy/environment stripping before pinned CLI launch;536-line file remains one enforcement catalogue with named validators, no edit proposed.
Browser unit tests assert local-origin/session/flag restrictions, marker exclusive creation, environment stripping and successful-close ownership release.
Journal privateRead rejects symlinks/public mode/oversize; exclusive fsynced lock spans reservation/journey, fail-closed initialization and atomic rename preserve quota even uncertain outcomes.

runJourney uses fixed synthetic source, validates preference/wallet, rechecks exact routing/budget/exposure before single dispatch, then requires persisted output/terminal billing/provider expense; retains timeout reservation.

Smoke deterministic fixtures validate real contracts and injected clock/API without paid calls; coverage includes lost outcomes quotas, lock/corrupt/private files, changed readiness, billing/output/expense and one-dispatch timeout.
Diagram catalogue confines realpaths, validates narrow frontmatter/Mermaid forms and fingerprints sorted source bytes; stamping is explicit author-only branch.
Checker initializes strict Mermaid in inert jsdom, validates all syntax before optional stamping, and exits nonzero on missing/invalid/stale catalog.
Diagram Playwright config starts isolated loopback server with no reuse, deterministic Chromium and failure traces.
Viewer inserts metadata as text, imports only strict Mermaid SVG and renderGeneration fences stale async output; fit/zoom/search/navigation are named bounded operations.
Viewer HTML uses native navigation/search/disclosures/buttons and live status/canvas region; static assets only, no embedded executable input.
Viewer CSS groups desktop/mobile sidebar, diagram canvas, zoom/source/freshness states; authored standalone tool styles remain cohesive with no semantic styling issue.
HTTP viewer rejects hostile Host/Origin/cross-site and mutations before confined asset/catalog reads; static/vendor allowlists, CSP, no-store and bounded timeouts expose read-only boundary.
Diagram E2E covers all real diagrams/navigation/zoom/search/mobile and synthetic source drift, inert notes, renderer failure and network recovery; cleanup isolated server/temp paths.
Viewer tests cover fingerprint drift/explicit stamp, metadata/directive/link rejection, symlink escape and real loopback hostile Host/Origin/path/method requests.
Skill checker narrow frontmatter/UI metadata parsers enforce exact names/fields/descriptions/prompt references and explicit-only skill policy; sorted repository iteration names every error source.
Skill fixture tests cover invocation policy, missing/extra UI metadata, default prompt references and name/description/line limits without filesystem writes.

Guide checker names frontmatter/section/E2E metadata/revision/marker/filesystem phases; exact registered commands and confined bounded regular test reads prevent untrusted guide execution. Large file is one validation grammar with named helpers, no controller extraction required.

Guide tests cover substantive required sections, index comments/fences, exact safe paths, token-safe diagnostics, revisions, unique/orphan/stale markers and symlink confinement; CLI inspect/check prove no run entrypoint.
Code-search tests use pinned resolved AST executable, synthetic TS/TSX/import fixtures and distinguish no-match1 from unsupported-language failure while asserting source unchanged.

Independently inspected root fix: hasValidBackendSelection preserves exact backend identity/file order/env/grep/file/minimum short-circuit checks; hasValidBrowserSelection names allowed app/file/grep contract. validateRegistry retains duplicate-ID-before-selection and shared completeness/error/dependency ordering; declarations and exports unchanged.

Registry fixtures derive suites by identity/required titles, mutate report/env/selection inputs to prove strict rejection and inject fake runners for timings/cleanup; loopback port conflict tests never borrow services.

Baseline scpBase reuses SSH lowercase-p port switch; TR-2 explicitly deferred by root because production/deployment correction is outside this readability improvement authority. No remote action or source change authorized/performed.

runDevelopment separates local target validation, redacted child output, ordered infra/build/migrations/readiness and owned descendant shutdown; same-process group retained for panel force-kill and exit stream drain bounded. Large orchestration already delegates output handling.

Development tests spawn only synthetic child scripts and cover local target guards, setup ordering/failure/interrupt, initializer timeout, nested cleanup, secret chunk redaction and bounded opaque log draining.

Readiness selects enabled/requested capabilities, groups format routes and evaluates explicit prerequisite checks; funding determines tariff/balance requirements and runtime alone requires matching fresh worker. Large check catalogue preserves actionable remedies and never claims generation success.

Readiness tests use synthetic snapshots/real fingerprint helper, cover routing/fallback, prices/cache, exact worker revisions, free versus paid wallet, credential evidence and database-authorized recovery; never dispatch providers.
CLI help smoke asserts pnpm separator support under PATH-only environment and no secret reads.

Multilingual-v1 stores12 engineering-authored correction/semantic translation/explanation references, explicit non-certification scope and no live-quality claim; all cases retain first-person meaning/no invented facts.
Fixture tests assert agreed language/version/unique IDs and correction/translation/explanation consistency without asserting model performance.

Configure validates reviewed profile and isolated deterministic server target, computes expected-version operations, validates all bodies before apply, defaults dry-run and never publishes routing/runs probes; nested log label is small status presentation.

Configure fixtures assert dry-run/no writes, idempotent normalized decimals, future-price rejection, synthetic-runtime precheck and stop-after-first conflict; client loopback/redaction and finite synthetic learner grant covered.
Target-binding tests independently reject deployed/remote/mismatched DB, actor identity mismatch and API/database revision differences before apply.
FSD tests lint synthetic aliases under real ESLint config, assert downward/same-app allowed and upward/sibling/cross-app/unclassified source forbidden including Next instrumentation.

Readability tests inspect real ESLint enrollment and braces/spacing, execute autofixed dangling-else/loop cases to prove behavior and check Prettier/idempotence; generated/history exclusions intentional.
Migration-classification tests require reviewed latest tag/content hash and reject contract-before-rollout or stale classification.
Manifest tests use disposable git ancestry and synthetic digest manifests; verify stable versions/exact images/migration identity, retired speech rejection and exclusive canonical CLI write.

Workflow tests read reviewed YAML as data, check manual/release-only triggers, pinned action SHAs, safe env interpolation, full preflight/build digests and protected serialized promotion without rebuilding.

Resource profiler separates local Docker guard, owned builder/build samples, steady/load/overlap phases and validated observation/history; record refuses dirty/incomplete builds and finally cleans builder/runtime ownership.
Resource runtime uses synthetic test-only secrets, loopback TLS edge and unique owned Compose projects; prepare/overlap/cleanup phases preserve blue/green/data/network order and best-effort teardown.

Accounting runner validates learner/admin disposable env first, preserves generated Next bytes and runs bounded serial accounting/legacy budgets/portrait/admin selections with signal forwarding; no default infra.
Contextual runner tests reject unsafe env, prove HTTP-before-browser selection/stop-on-failure, restore exact generated bytes/missing-file state and exclusive preservation lock cleanup.
Flashcard runner refuses preexisting named containers, tracks only created resources, waits bounded readiness, injects confirmed disposable targets and cleans reverse order.
Flashcard fake-runner tests verify exact target overrides, no reuse/no foreign cleanup, partial startup cleanup and failure propagation without Docker.
Portrait fake-runner tests require explicit confirmed dedicated targets, assert exact serial HTTP/browser commands and restore original env in finally.
Mastra runner refuses preexisting container, starts single loopback disposable PostgreSQL, polls bounded readiness and cleans only successfully started owned container.
Sentence runner validates explicit allow/confirm, dedicated name/nondefault loopback ports and Redis DB1..15 before exact journey; no fallback infrastructure.
Sentence fake-runner tests verify exact selected test file and reject defaults/mismatched DB/Redis before command dispatch with env restoration.
Combined Texts runner enforces exact dedicated DB/ports/Redis, forbids server reuse, probes app ports and executes backend then web with signal listener cleanup.
Combined Texts environment tests reject alternate test DB, remote host, server reuse and unexpected DB/Redis port/database before reset.
Texts runner validates confirmed explicit loopback dedicated name and nondefault PG/Redis pair before one exact API/system journey; container lifecycle remains caller-owned.
Texts fake-runner tests assert exact mapped journey and reject foreign/default/unconfirmed targets, restoring env after injected execution.
Preference fake-runner tests require dedicated confirmed DB/Redis and exact mapped journey, with process env restored even failure.
inspectUserFlowE2e separately validates guide/test/global markers then maps scenarios for safe output; CLI allowlists inspect/check only and never executes registered guide text.

findings.problem: Negated ternary combines exact backend selection equality/order/env/minimum invariants with browser app/file/grep checks, obscuring separate contracts.
findings.suggestion: Use named private backend/browser selection predicates or explicit branches, preserving short-circuit/first-error semantics.
findings.resolution: Root extracted ordered backend/browser predicates and named validSelection. Independent diff review finds all original checks and first-error/read ordering retained. Root-reported existing23 tests and1782 differential invalid-flow cases passed; reviewer did not rerun tests.

findings.problem: SSH lowercase -p port flag is reused for scp, whose port flag is uppercase -P; lowercase -p preserves times and the numeric port is misparsed as source operand.
findings.suggestion: Separate scp argument builder with uppercase -P, following admin-membership-remote pattern; prove via synthetic command capture without remote execution.
findings.resolution: Root explicitly deferred baseline production/deployment correction; no remote actions authorized or performed.
